Two Italian technicians were killed in Kuwait in a drone attack on a site where they serviced an air-defence system; Kuwait and Italy blamed Iran, which denies it.
A Houthi strike on a refinery in Jazan, Saudi Arabia, killed a worker from Nepal and halted operations, the Saudi energy ministry said.
Trump told US troops he sent an extra aircraft carrier to the region and would strike Pickaxe Mountain near Natanz if fighting resumes.
Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Tula region and St Petersburg overnight and seriously damaged a Krasnodar refinery; Zelensky warns a massive Russian strike is coming.
Latvia scrambled NATO jets after a drone briefly entered its airspace near the Russian border; Estonia issued an air-threat warning.
A European Commission report says Russia's crude export revenue for January-September 2026 already exceeds all of 2025, citing the Middle East crisis.
Ukraine's military intelligence says North Korea paused arms deliveries to Russia; the claim is unverified.
Turkey completed ratification of the Mecca defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.
